listing.name: F.E.A.R. Files (Xbox 360) — F.E.A.R. 360 Recompiled (Juansolo457)
listing.summary: Build F.E.A.R. Files locally from your Xbox 360 files. Upstream reports gameplay, but complete playthroughs of both expansions remain unconfirmed and effects/performance issues remain. Native Linux is untested. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 F.E.A.R. Files, title ID 565507E8, with default.xex and Game/ under port-files/assets/. Check docs/SETUP.md for the required region, revision and hash before preparing files. Base F.E.A.R., title ID 565507D9, is a different game. The optional Files PC texture pack requires your own corresponding PC files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: For source-only version 0.1.0, prepare the patched SDK with tools/setup-sdk.ps1, then locally compile this title using tools/build-nx.ps1 -Project port-files. tools/launch.ps1 -Collection can select it after independent preparation. No public compiled game/player archive is offered by the README; keep your own disc data local under port-files/assets/.

warnings: Upstream reports gameplay and 4K/80 FPS with an optional texture pack made from your own PC files, plus a right-stick fix. Smoke/effects, optimization and complete playthroughs of both expansion campaigns remain unfinished or unconfirmed. Base-game fixes do not necessarily apply. Native Linux is untested, Steam Deck uses experimental Proton and Android ARM64 work has not started. Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
